chunks: Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from al-Fadl ibn Shazaan, from Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from al-Halbi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about the brothers from the mother, with the grandfather, so he said: For the brothers from the mother, their legislated share is one-third, with the grandfather.

key_terms.الْإِخْوَةِ مِنَ الْأُمِّ: Maternal half-brothers (sharing the same mother but different fathers)
key_terms.الْجَدِّ: The grandfather (specifically the paternal grandfather in this context)

ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of maternal half-brothers when inheriting with the grandfather?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the specific inheritance share of maternal half-brothers (إخوة من الأم) as one-third when they inherit alongside the paternal grandfather, a ruling derived from the general principle in Surah An-Nisa. In Shia jurisprudence, this establishes the grandfather's role as a primary heir who does not exclude these maternal siblings, distinguishing the distribution from cases where the grandfather might exclude other relatives. The narration underscores the precision of the Imams in defining fractional shares (fara'id) within the broader Quranic framework of inheritance.
